parse.title: Face Trader
parse.wikitext:
{{Event Header|Event-FaceTrader.png}} {{E|Face Trader}} is a {{QueryLink|Events|shrine:Yes|shrine Event}} found in [[Act 1]] and [[Act 2]]. This Event is the only way to obtain {{R|Cultist Headpiece}}, {{R|Face of Cleric}}, {{R|Gremlin Visage}}, {{R|N'loth's Hungry Face}}, and {{R|Ssserpent Head}}. It is one of the events affected by {{Asc|15|Ascension}}. ==Options== {{Frame|Touch}} {{TS|negative||Lose X HP,}} {{TS|positive||gain 75 {{Asc|15|(50)}} [[Gold]].}} * X is equal to 10% of the player's Max HP, rounded down. {{Frame|Trade}} {{TS|positive||50%: Good Face.}} {{TS|negative||50%: Bad Face.}} * Receive one of the following special [[Relics]]: ** {{R|Face of Cleric}} ({{TS|positive||good face}}) ** {{R|Ssserpent Head}} ({{TS|positive||good face}}) ** {{R|Gremlin Visage}} ({{TS|negative||bad face}}) ** {{R|N'loth's Hungry Face}} ({{TS|negative||bad face}}) ** {{R|Cultist Headpiece}} (neutral face) {{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens. ==Dialogue==
You walk by an eerie statue holding several masks...
Something behind you softly whispers,
{{TS||up|"Stop."}}
{{Frame|Continue}}
You swerve around to face the statue which is now facing you!
On closer inspection, it's not a statue but a statuesque, gaunt man. Is he even breathing?
{{TS||up|"Face. Let me touch? Maybe trade?"}}
{{Frame|Touch}}
{{TS||up|"Compensation? Compensation."}}
Mechanically, he cranes out a neat stack of {{TS|gold||gold}} and places it in your pouch.
{{TS||up|"What a nice face. Nice face."}}
While he touches your face, you begin to feel your life drain out of it!
During this, his mask falls off and shatters. Screaming, he quickly covers his face with all six arms dropping even more masks! Amidst all the screaming and shattering, you escape.
His face was completely blank.
{{Frame|Trade}}
{{TS||up|"For me?}} {{TS||shake|FOR ME?}} {{TS||up|Oh yes.. Yes. Yes.. mmm..."}}
You see one of his arms flicker, and your face is in its hand! Your face has been swapped.
{{TS||up|"Nice face. Nice face."}}
{{Frame|Leave}}
{{TS||up|"Stop. Stop. Stop. Stop. Stop."}}
This was probably the right call.
==Notes== * The chances stated by the Event are inaccurate. The actual chances are 40% good face, 40% bad face, and 20% neutral face ({{R|Cultist Headpiece}}). ** All 5 masks have the same probability of being chosen. ==Trivia== * The masks held by the Face Trader in his portrait resemble other characters seen in the game. ** From left to right, up to down: [[N'loth]], [[We Meet Again!|Ranwid]], [[The Cleric|Cleric]], the [[The Ssssserpent|Ssserpent]], [[Masked Bandits#Pointy|Pointy]], and [[Masked Bandits#Bear|Bear]]. ==Update History== * '''Patch V2.0: The Watcher''' ** Face Trader event can no longer appear past Act 2. * '''Weekly Patch 51: Recursion''' ** Minor text cleanup for Face Trader event. * '''Weekly Patch 40: Forethought''' ** Face Trader event will no longer give out duplicate relics on Endless mode. * '''Weekly Patch 33: Terror''' ** Improved Face Trader wording for top option to better reflect what happens. * '''Weekly Patch 32: Face Trader''' ** Face Trader: It's a new event! This event shows up in any Act and can give you 1 of 5 relics exclusive to this event, we think it's facetastic. ** Adding the Face Trader event. {{EventNav}} [[Category:Events]]
